summary:
I have identified and fixed the race condition in the counter implementation. 

The non-atomic read-modify-write pattern (`get` followed by `set`) in `/app/app/counter.js` was causing increments to be lost under high concurrency. I replaced it with the atomic `INCR` command provided by Redis. 

I've also run `test.sh`, and the test passes successfully, confirming that all 100 concurrent increments are now correctly accounted for.
